== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Solomahal (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Solomahal (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. The whole earlier image and the whole new image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
